items.statement: Two doses at Day 1 and Day 29, 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection) per dose
items.supporting_quote:
Dosing Schedule: Two doses (Day 1 and Day 29)
Dose: 100 mcg (0.5 mL IM injection)

items.subject: mRNA-1273.222-P301
items.statement: COVID-19 ≥14 days post-dose 2 with vaccine efficacy 93.6% (95% CI: 90.6%, 94.6%), p-value < 0.0001; 11/255 vaccine recipients vs 180/255 placebo recipients

items.subject: mRNA-1273.222-P301
items.statement: Severe COVID-19 with vaccine efficacy 99.4%; 3/255 vaccine recipients vs 34/255 placebo recipients, p-value < 0.0001

items.subject: mRNA-1273.222-P301
items.statement: Injection site pain (94%), fatigue (66%), headache (66%), and myalgia (57%); majority were mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days
items.supporting_quote: The most common solicited adverse events were injection site pain (94%), fatigue (66%), headache (66%), and myalgia (57%). The majority of adverse events were mild to moderate and resolved within 1-3 days.

items.subject: mRNA-1273.222-P301
items.statement: Seroconversion rate 98.2% at 28 days post-dose 2 with geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 of 916 (95% CI: 794 – 2093)
items.supporting_quote: Geometric mean titers (GMTs) at Day 57 were 916 (95% CI: 794 – 2093). Seroconversion rates were 98.2% at 28 days post-dose 2.
